records.rationale: Retain exec_update_lock write trylock and final unlock to serialize competing TSYNC operations. A blocking acquisition could deadlock two synchronizing sibling threads. Native signal/task-work algorithms remain unchanged apart from separately attributed OEM storage/export additions.

additional_local_history: Queried existing local mainline 9e947d96915af63e28896caae85a81b74855621b Landlock TSYNC history; no additional mainline code was imported.
scope: Full candidate patches; initial/final TSYNC source comparison; native credential hooks, caller prerequisites, commit/abort and native task-work/restart functions; current configuration and scoped Android searches. Removal commit a96c98dd7a30 examined only for the six exports, not its entire deletion.
security: TSYNC intentionally replaces sibling Landlock domains and logging state irrespective of existing restrictions. A less restricted sibling can therefore relax another sibling Landlock configuration. Preserve this explicit opt-in ACK API for compatibility, with sibling threads sharing policy authority; do not describe it as monotonic per-thread confinement. The caller still must satisfy native no_new_privs or CAP_SYS_ADMIN checks, ruleset validation/merging and maximum layer rules. No-new-privs is propagated when set and never cleared. Different credentials are prepared from each sibling and only the Landlock blob is replaced; identical credentials may share the new credential reference. Native other-LSM checks and filesystem/network access checks remain. Allocation failure, signal cancellation and serialized retry were source-reviewed, not concurrency-tested.
uncertainty: SDK runtime use of TSYNC is unconfirmed. Searches of pinned system, bionic, frameworks, packages and device trees located generic syscall exposure and generated/prebuilt names, but no definite TSYNC caller. This does not prove it is unnecessary: retain this configured generic userspace security interface conservatively, without adding a future platform. Broader per-application assumptions about thread isolation and runtime scheduling behavior remain unverified.
